find:
for (const cb of pickHullCbs) cb(swatch.id);
      if ((e as MouseEvent).detail > 0) b.blur();
replace:
for (const cb of pickHullCbs) cb(swatch.id);
      b.blur();
why: A hull pick blurs unconditionally, so a keyboard or controller player who presses Enter on a swatch loses their place in the pane's roving focus. The `detail > 0` guard is what tells a pointer click from a keyboard activation. Under this mutation all 116 tests in hud.controls.test.ts and hud.a11y.test.ts passed (local control run while issue #556 was open).
killedBy: renderCustomizeChoices (issue #556) a button in the hull row keeps focus when the keyboard presses it, and lets go after a pointer click
